comment: model and animation fields represent file names located in assets/isleofberk/geo/entity/*dragon ID*/ and assets/isleofberk/animations/entity/*dragon ID*/ respectively
*dragon ID* represents path part in entity's ID. I.e. for Deadly Nadder dragon ID would be deadly_nadder, for Gronckle - gronckle. Exception is Monstrous Nightmare. It'll be just nightmare
similar story goes for eggs, but folders for textures are very scuffed for each dragon, so please refer to IoB jar file for that
